title: Use-after-free in the DOM: Bindings (WebIDL) component
description: CVE-2026-8947 is a use-after-free vulnerability in the DOM Bindings (WebIDL) component of Microsoft software version 4.0. This type of flaw involves accessing memory after it has been freed, which can lead to unpredictable behavior or potential exploitation. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
